foundSpecPath writes `specPath, _ := engine.ResolveSpecPath(...)` and ignores the found bool. On a miss the callee returns an unresolved path. InFlightAuditRound then stats that path's state dir, gets no snapshot and returns 0. foundAuditUnitFinder (40-46) then files an audit unit's request with AuditRound 0, so tp found apply does not hold it until its round is recorded (§7). --audit-row gets a misleading 'no audit round in flight' refusal. Pinned-surface guard: no file writes, no locks, no dropped errors. Nothing in go-safety's domain.

Every error is propagated: LoadReviewState (only a rebuildable index is tolerated, on purpose) and ReadAuditPools, which returns ENOENT as found=false and wraps parse errors with %w. The row key is checked before use. No writes, so no lock or permission concerns.
